thread:
marie (PR): ok team — mini scramble. we have 3 analyst brief slots to lock: NA morning, EU late-afternoon, APAC overnight. embargo lift is 9am PT. can ppl confirm availability and quote clearance pings?

alex (Marketing): I can take NA and APAC handoffs. NA slot = 9:30am PT works for spokes. APAC overnight — need someone to stay for followups or we do async?

diego (Product): happy to join EU slot. quick ask: which benchmark numbers are green to share? latency/cost graphs or only summary?

marie (PR): share summary + one chart (latency vs open-model baseline). product will attach the chart and the one-liner quote. legal already okayed the core messaging but wants final quote text before embargo.

sam (CEO): put me in the EU slot if we need exec presence; otherwise I can record a short standby note.

alex (Marketing): noted. who owns the approved quote? we need the exact string for press kit and the embargoed email.

diego (Product): draft quote for approval: 

```
"Redwood Inference delivers predictable, low-latency inference at a fraction of the cost of unmanaged deployments, enabling teams to ship LLM features faster."\n```

marie (PR): that reads well. legal asks to replace "fraction" with "significant reduction". also add attribution: — Sam Altman-style? jk — "— Alexis Nguyen, CEO, Redwood Inference"

sam (CEO): change looks fine, but please remove the comma after CEO. final: "— Sam Kim, CEO Redwood Inference"

alex (Marketing): updated. final quote ready: 

```
"Redwood Inference delivers predictable, low-latency inference with a significant reduction in unit cost, enabling teams to ship LLM features faster." — Sam Kim, CEO Redwood Inference
```

marie (PR): perfect. diego pls attach the latency graph and the single-sentence bench methodology note (1 line: dataset + prompt length). also send fact-check list: top 5 datapoints that journalists will ask.

diego (Product): attaching in thread (will DM live files): latency graph (p95 tokens/sec), cost-per-1000-tokens estimate, model versions tested, test corpus, prompt len avg=64. fact-check list: 1) p95 latency, 2) throughput per GPU, 3) quantization used, 4) dataset provenance, 5) billing model.

marie (PR): great. alex — can you schedule calendar invites w/ embargo notes and attach the press kit (PDF) + analytics link? Need invites out by EOD.

alex (Marketing): will send invites. question on embargo phrasing: "under embargo until 9am PT on <date>" ok? and do we list a reporter RSVP cutoff?

marie (PR): yes to embargo phrasing. set RSVP cutoff 2 hours before NA slot. note for APAC: we'll provide a recorded exec snippet for those who can't make the overnight.

launch-bot: Calendar invites created for 2024-06-12 — NA 9:30am PT, EU 5:00pm BST, APAC 1:00am SGT. invites include embargo text, press kit link, and quote.

sam (CEO): thx. final ask — can we get a one-paragraph safe-answer for tricky Qs (security/data isolation)? PR + Product to draft.

marie (PR): on it. diego will add technical bullet. I'll post the safe-answer here for quick copy/paste into replies.

diego (Product): adding short safe-answer: "Redwood supports private VPC deployments and integrates with customer KMS/HSM; no customer data is used for model training and audit logs are available on request."

marie (PR): awesome. I'll publish the press email template now and ping media list. :thumbsup:
